mapper.sql: id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, type, payload_json, status, retry_count, last_error, created_at, next_attempt_at, processed_at
mapper.insert: insert into nad_outbox_event (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, type, payload_json, status, retry_count, created_at, next_attempt_at) values (#{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{type}, #{payloadJson}, 'PENDING', 0, now(), now())
mapper.select: select from nad_outbox_event where status = 'PENDING' and next_attempt_at <= now() order by next_attempt_at asc, id asc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from nad_outbox_event where status = #{status}
